cohort: 18,207 pregnant women attending the antenatal clinic at ESICMC & PGIMSR, Bangalore between January 2006 and December 2011.
finding: Among 18,207 pregnant women, 66 (0.36%) tested positive for HIV; all children available for follow-up tested HIV negative at various time points.
mod_finding: Among the HIV-positive women, 20 (34.5%) delivered by cesarean section and 38 (65.5%) delivered vaginally.
